notes.title: 游戏性优化/指引和交互
notes.notes:
What's new in this update:
A simple update, but with a big change
Each text added has a question mark callout guide, and the crosshair can be directly aimed at the question mark to interact
Other items (keys and batteries) have been optimized to interact with each other so that they can now be interacted with next to items with their crosshairs aligned

Thank you all for your support of  (Fear Deeps) ! Whether it's a bad review or a good review, we will continue to improve
Deep in Fear is not a major development project for our studio
The income of this game is only for the cost of preparing for the development of the next game, so at the beginning this game (Fear Deeps) was not made so carefully, nor was it well optimized, and most importantly, there was no guidance, resulting in many players having no purpose, I am sorry for the irreversible impact on your game experience, our studio will never make this mistake again in the future, even if it is to make a niche game, we will make it well next time, and make it with heart.

The studio is still in its infancy, everyone needs to grow, and every game needs to be updated
Thank you again for your support
If you want to know the latest trends or updates of the game, you can also join our QQ group: 1009670494

notes.title: 游戏BUG修复以及优化Game bug fixes and optimizations
notes.notes:
[b]I'm sorry that the game started with various bugs and didn't have any important hints
This has led to a lot of dissatisfaction among many players, but now these more important issues have been resolved
Thank you for your support, thank you! [/b]

Fixed an issue where inhibitors would not work when used through doors
Fixed the issue that the inhibitor would continue to spray after it ran out
Fixed an issue where mobs (doctors) could not enter the room
Fixed an issue where Lily (the boss) would not backstab the player
Fixed an issue where Lily would move after death
Added quest hints for Ending 1
Added a question mark hint for the opening toilet in the nursing home
Optimization: Exit keys will only appear in the basement under certain circumstances
Fixed the issue that some text errors were fixed
Changed Lily to be teleported to the first floor when the player reached the third floor (instead of being stuck by two NPCs on the third floor)
